Not covered: forced internal-exception -> analyzer status 'failed' path (see "TestStrategyPacket items not implemented" below).

TestStrategyPacket items not implemented, with reason:
- No dedicated forced-internal-exception test for the `runAndroidComposeSemanticAnalyzer` try/catch 'failed' status path. Reason: no existing sibling Android analyzer test (android-components, android-navigation, etc.) exercises this path either — there is no established fixture/mocking pattern in this repository for forcibly triggering an internal analyzer exception, and inventing one (e.g. via module-mocking) would be a new test-infrastructure pattern not otherwise justified by this narrow batch. The try/catch itself directly mirrors the exact, already-precedented `runAndroidComponentsAnalyzer` shape.
- No dedicated "extremely large file near MAX_SCAN_LINES" performance/truncation test, matching test-strategy-packet.txt's explicitly-flagged noncritical coverage gap (trusted by analogy to buildComposeNavigationRoutes.ts's own equivalent, independently-tested truncation behavior).
- TST-002's automated responsibility-mapping entry in the raw capsule shows "partially-mapped" (criticality: noncritical) rather than "fully-mapped" — the underlying test (parameter extraction) is nonetheless present and passing; the raw capsule's mapping-completeness heuristic and this report's actual test coverage are not perfectly reconciled for this one noncritical item, consistent with the general context-gate limitation documented in test-context-packet.txt.
